name: components-community-pin-list
title: Pin List
description: A two-part list of menu items: clicking a row pins it to the top section, clicking again sends it back below the All Items divider, and rows spring between groups.
use: Users should keep a few list or menu entries at the top while the rest stay in a general group.
avoid: Pinning is a click on the whole row with no button, so touch users get no hint and keyboards cannot reach it.
a11y: Rows are clickable divs with no role, tabindex or aria-pressed, so pinning is mouse-only and its state is never announced. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Rounded grey rows on a black stage, each with a small square icon tile, a bold name, a grey caption and a circular pin badge on the right. A faded All Items label separates the pinned rows from the rest.
behaves: Clicking any row flips its pinned state and the row springs from one section to the other while its neighbours shift to make room. Unpinned rows reveal their pin button only under the cursor; pinned rows keep theirs filled.
customise: Items, group labels, spring transition and per-section class names are props; the row markup and pin badge styling need a source edit.
weight: light: A handful of rows with layout animations; idle at rest.
